Method of Attack: Ransomware operation involving extortion of victims through encryption and ransom negotiation; Affiliate transfer of victims from BlackMatter to LockBit for continued ransom negotiation
Impacted Systems: Victims of ransomware attacks targeted by BlackMatter and LockBit ransomware gangs
Attack Vector: Ransomware infection and negotiation via Tor sites and hacking forums
Indicators of Compromise: Withdrawal of 4 Bitcoins (~$250,000) from Exploit forum
Deactivation and deletion of posts/accounts on hacking forums
